title: Scan Performance Metrics — Pipeline Throughput, Accuracy, and Artifact Reuse
authority: SESSION350_V1_BASELINE.json (Board A); SESSION321_SCAN_PIPELINE_SPEC.json; scripts/output/certification_scan_artifact.json (S322 live pipeline run)
purpose: Measure the performance of the Framework v2 scan pipeline — the core 'scan once, consume many' architecture. Tracks pipeline runtime, defect detection accuracy (false positives/negatives), cross-board artifact reuse, and per-gate effectiveness.

scan_pipeline_architecture.description: 7-gate deterministic linear pipeline: Gate -1 → Gate 0 → Gate 1 → Gate 2 → Gate 3 → Gate 4 → Gate 5. Each gate depends on the previous gate's output. The final output is the CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT consumed by all Framework v2 boards.

gates.name: Identity Validation
gates.description: Validates that every item has a valid, unique compound-key identity. Items that fail are BLOCKED.

gates.name: JSON Integrity
gates.description: Ensures all question objects parse correctly with required fields present.

gates.name: Structural Scan
gates.description: Scans for structural defects: EW[CC] non-empty, empty non-CC slots, metadata offsets.

gates.name: Content Scan
gates.description: Scans for content-quality issues: boilerplate, missing citations, difficulty inflation.

gates.name: Identity Reconciliation
gates.description: Validates cross-pack compound-key uniqueness. Detects identity collisions.

gates.name: Calculation Validation
gates.description: Validates CorrectChoice against explanation content. Full calculation validation deferred to S332.

gates.name: Certification Readiness
gates.description: Aggregates all gate results. Produces final CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT. Deferred to S332.

SP-001_pipeline_runtime.description: Wall-clock time from pipeline initiation to CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT generation. Measured per gate and aggregated.
SP-001_pipeline_runtime.formula: pipeline_runtime = Σ gate_runtime for all operational gates
SP-001_pipeline_runtime.current_s322: 0.7s (lightweight stubs — will increase as full gate implementations deploy in S332)

SP-002_items_scanned_per_second.description: Throughput of the scan pipeline in items per second.
SP-002_items_scanned_per_second.current_s322: 2,540 items / 0.7s = 3,629 items/second (stub implementation — not representative of full gate performance)

SP-003_false_positive_rate.metric: False Positive Rate per Defect Class
SP-003_false_positive_rate.description: Rate at which defect scanners flag non-defects. A false positive is a scan-triggered defect that manual verification confirms does not exist.

historical_v1_false_positive_rate.DL-008_scans: ~75% on Pack B (DL-029 forward-scan artifacts produced false positives on every Pack B item with CC-before-QID ordering). 257 Pack B false positives documented.
historical_v1_false_positive_rate.root_cause: QID-forward-scan methodology (now FORBIDDEN under FM-001 through FM-008)

SP-003_false_positive_rate.v2_target: <5% false positive rate per defect class
SP-003_false_positive_rate.verification_method: For each defect class flagged by scan: manual review of a 10% random sample to confirm true/false positive ratio.

SP-004_false_negative_rate.metric: False Negative Rate per Defect Class
SP-004_false_negative_rate.description: Rate at which defect scanners miss real defects. A false negative is a real defect that the scan failed to detect.
SP-004_false_negative_rate.verification_method: For Certified items: retroactive scan to detect previously missed defects (leakage events). For known-defect items: verify scan catches all known instances.
SP-004_false_negative_rate.v2_target: <1% false negative rate per defect class (must catch all structural defects in Certified pool)
SP-004_false_negative_rate.notes: False negatives on Certified items are readiness leakage events — the most critical scan failure mode.

SP-005_artifact_reuse_rate.description: Measure of 'scan once, consume many' effectiveness. How many boards consume the same scan artifact vs. running their own scans?
SP-005_artifact_reuse_rate.v1_baseline: 0% reuse — each board ran its own independent scans on the same items (2.5:1 duplication ratio)
SP-005_artifact_reuse_rate.v2_target: 100% reuse — all 5 boards consume the same CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT

SP-006_scan_redundancy_ratio.description: How many times the same defect class is scanned per wave. v1: DL-008 was scanned 22 times across 6 sessions. v2: DL-008 is scanned once per pipeline run.

v1_baseline.DL-008: 22 scans / ~14 waves = 1.57 scans per wave (some waves scanned DL-008 3-4 times)

SP-006_scan_redundancy_ratio.v2_target: 1.0 per wave for every defect class — scanned once, results consumed by all boards

scan_once_consume_many.label: Scan Once, Consume Many — Architecture and Verification
scan_once_consume_many.description: The CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT is generated once per session (at T0). All 5 Framework v2 boards consume this single artifact. No board runs its own independent scans.

consumers.consumes: Per-item gate results (Gate 1, Gate 2). Filters to READY and MINOR_FIX items only.
Aggregate certification readiness from Gate 5. Per-item CAQS scores.
Full defect inventory. BLOCKED/REMEDIATE item lists for triage.
Identity validation results from Gate -1. Compound key registry updates.

drift_detection.description: If pack files change mid-session (e.g., content remediation), the artifact must be regenerated.
drift_detection.mechanism: Drift detection compares pack file hashes at T0 and Tmid. If hash change detected, re-run affected gates and regenerate CERTIFICATION_SCAN_ARTIFACT. All boards are notified of the artifact version change.

current_operational_snapshot_s322.analysis: Gate 1 is the primary bottleneck: 274 items blocked (all DL-026 — empty non-CC EW slots). Gate 2 issues widespread warnings (2,075 EV3 — missing accounting principle citations). These are soft-fail, not hard-fail — they don't block certification but should be acknowledged. Gate -1: 1 item blocked (Pack D, empty CorrectChoice). The scan pipeline at S322 is operational with lightweight stubs — total runtime 0.7s demonstrates the orchestration layer works.
